description: BUG-11: suspects scanned every text file, so it guessed at lockfiles and wrappers (generated or vendored - a path in one is a fact about a build tool) and at .gitignore (which holds patterns, not references, so reporting one inverts its meaning). A built-in skip list covers the never-authored sources, and .reflockignore stays the escape hatch for anything else. The hand-written app.py is still scanned.
